items.purpose: Implement the already specified adult single-allergy access-attempt audit profile
security_requirements: Authenticated producer and current per-resource policy
Patient-only receipt query; revoked clinical grant does not remove historical accountability
Fail closed when integrity/policy/source is unavailable
backend_work: Transactional append and producer dedupe; lock tenant integrity stream before grant and dedupe
Commit audit, receipt and outbox atomically before acknowledgement
database_work: Unique tenant+producer+event_id and grant projection sequence
tests: Two producers and grants cannot fork tenant chain
acceptance_criteria: One durable effect for identical retry; changed body conflicts
No acknowledged event loss under injected restart

items.purpose: Implement the already specified adult single-allergy access-attempt audit profile
security_requirements: Authenticated producer and current per-resource policy
Patient-only receipt query; revoked clinical grant does not remove historical accountability
Fail closed when integrity/policy/source is unavailable
backend_work: Snapshot pagination, opaque bound cursors and self-audit without recursion
frontend_work: Patient receipt list with attempt-versus-delivery wording
Empty/unavailable/withheld states without inferred absence of access
database_work: Grant/patient projection, cursor epoch and snapshot bounds
tests: Clinical grant revoked but current patient self-read allowed
Receipt policy revocation denies; stale cursor fails
acceptance_criteria: All negative authorization cases disclose no receipt existence
One query self-audit outside captured snapshot

items.purpose: Implement the already specified adult single-allergy access-attempt audit profile
security_requirements: Authenticated producer and current per-resource policy
Patient-only receipt query; revoked clinical grant does not remove historical accountability
Fail closed when integrity/policy/source is unavailable
backend_work: Quarantined restore, checkpoint verification and projection/outbox reconciliation
Bounded telemetry and numerical synthetic load acceptance
frontend_work: Explicit unavailable state; no stale clinical fallback
database_work: Restore manifest and epoch reset; retain immutable acknowledgement identity
api_work: Verify no-store and closed error behavior during outages
tests: Log/cache redaction and 20 append +20 query/sec synthetic load
acceptance_criteria: p99 append <=500ms and query <=1s at declared load, measured during implementation
No real patient use without external gates
